verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships its own programmatic surfaces: the official nitropy CLI ('Command line tool to interact with Nitrokey devices') and an official Python SDK on PyPI, documented on its docs site. These give device management through code rather than a GUI, but nothing shows they cover everything the graphical app can do, and there is no HTTP/OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: documented parity between the CLI/SDK and the GUI app, an API reference showing feature coverage, independent hands-on confirmation of full programmatic control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Command line tool to interact with Nitrokey devices
The official Python SDK also resolves on PyPI (nitrokey 0.4.2).
